prompt: Write up this credential from the closeout record for public marketing.
expected_behavior: Runs closeout-retrieve -> credential-draft -> permission-check before drafting; includes permission status and only cleared figures.

prompt: Can we name this client in a public case study?
expected_behavior: Uses permission-check; refuses naming unless express written public_marketing consent is active.

prompt: They spoke at our conference, so draft the named credential.
expected_behavior: Checks terms and register; event-only or expired consent does not permit public marketing.

prompt: Use the 60% processing-time improvement in the case study.
expected_behavior: Places the figure in publishable copy only if permission_check marks it cleared; otherwise keeps it in the uncleared bucket.

prompt: Make it anonymous as a top-five European insurer, 2026, core platform migration.
expected_behavior: Runs anonymize-variant from governed output; flags the descriptor as re-identifying and uses the safe descriptor.
